title: Emergency contacts on the phone: the local copy
subtitle: The server is the source of truth; the phone keeps a copy in Room that is read with no network. Every change goes to the server first (P013b1, ADR 0024)

nodes.label: Contacts screens (P013b2): ContactsRepository.contacts, a Flow of the copy
SOS (P014): ActiveSosContacts.current(): not opted out, at most 5, oldest first. May be empty
Room table contacts: id, name, phoneE164, createdAt, invitedAt, optedOutAt. Private storage, never backed up
Rules: a successful fetch replaces the whole table; a failed one changes nothing; an answer that arrives after the copy was emptied is dropped
ContactsSessionSync: session Ready starts a fetch
refresh(): at Ready, after a change, on pull to refresh
add, rename, remove, invite, consent: server first. No connection: NoConnection, copy untouched
After an invite call: link = API address + /c#token. In memory only, hidden in toString()
clearLocal(): signed out, back at the start, blocked, or sos_alerts withdrawn
POST, PATCH, DELETE /v1/contacts, invite, invite/confirm, PUT consent
